user.title: Connect Chemist Warehouse
user.description:
Only prescriptions sent to Chemist Warehouse Online New Zealand (the online dispensary) are supported. Prescriptions sent to or held by local stores are not tracked.

This is an independent, unofficial integration, not affiliated with, supported by, endorsed by, or sponsored by Chemist Warehouse.

Enter your Chemist Warehouse New Zealand account credentials. Prescription statuses are checked every 6 hours.
